source.author: ov
source.text: , illa quidem pugnat: sed quem superare puella, quisve Iovem poterat? Superum petit aethera victor Iuppiter: huic odio nemus est et conscia silva.
source.text_original: , / illa quidem pugnat: sed quem superare puella, / quisve Iovem poterat? —  Superum petit aethera victor / Iuppiter: huic odio nemus est et conscia silva.
source.text_english: She indeed fights; but what girl could overcome him, or who could overcome Jupiter? Jupiter, victorious, makes for the upper air of heaven: to him the grove is hateful, and the forest, privy to the deed.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: flecte ratem motusque, pater, nec vulnere nostro aequora pande viris: veteris sat conscia luctus silva Padi et viso flentes genitore sorores.
reuse.text_original: flecte ratem motusque, pater, nec vulnere nostro / aequora pande viris: veteris sat conscia luctus / silva Padi et viso flentes genitore sorores.
reuse.text_english: Turn the ship aside and the course, father, and do not reveal the seas to the men by our wound: enough to know the ancient grief are the woods of the Padus and the sisters weeping at sight of their father.
